svg.title: The paperwork does itself. You do the building.
svg.desc: YaVaKa removes the administrative weight of build management: stage tracking, receipts, client updates and reporting are generated from the work you record.
svg.text: Three things managers lose hours to every week. All three are produced
by the system the moment the stage or the payment is recorded.
Stage and balance changes sent by email and WhatsApp
Portfolio and project packs, ready to hand over
Every payment tied to the document that proves it
Every receipt, invoice and document — at every
stage — in your YaVaKa portal. Private to your
